title: Special floor area regulations
previewText: The maximum floor area ratio for zoning lots containing only standard residences, or such residential uses with community facility or commercial uses, shall be 3.33. The maximum floor area ratio for zoning lots containing qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing shall be 4.0.
